note: The resources block (package 33): numbers of the UI, not game rules. order = the main resources top to bottom (then the class pools); tokens = the theme colour of each; buttons = the mechanics buttons under each (take_damage / heal / damage_to_balance open their dialog, minus / plus = adjust_value -1 / +1, overload_minus / overload_plus = adjust_value overload); modes = the auto-switch minimum heights (px at 100 %); thin_min = the smallest thin bar; row_overhead / block_overhead = the space of a label and a button row / of the title and the message line (px at 100 %); large_pools = how many pools are drawn large; compact_visible = compact pool rows shown before the list scrolls; temp_step = the temp HP strip segment (points); damage_max = the largest number of the damage and editor fields.
